services.name: Jiu Jitsu
services.desc: Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu has evolved significantly since Maeda introduced Japanese style Jiu-Jitsu to the Gracie family in Brazil nearly 100 years ago. Since then the art and practice of Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu has adapted and changed to suit the environment in which it is practiced; From Mixed Martial Arts settings to Collegiate-Style Competition, Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu means a variety of things to the body of practitioners in the United States and elsewhere in the world. Classes at the academy are held in both gi and no-gi, and are taught with a “feet to floor” mentality - that is, instruction and sparring sessions spend equal time in the standing position as on the ground.
